ui_bugs.issue: Login form doesn't work - modal stays open after clicking Sign In with valid demo credentials (aryan@demo.com / demo1234)

integration_issues.issue: Frontend auth modal not properly integrating with backend auth APIs despite backend working perfectly

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix authentication modal integration issue. The backend auth APIs work perfectly (tested and confirmed), but the frontend auth modal form is not properly handling the login flow. When users click Sign In with valid credentials, the modal should close and user should be logged in with personalized greeting. Currently the modal stays open and no authentication occurs. This is blocking the entire user authentication flow and preventing testing of logged-in features like submit form, dashboard, event joining, etc.
